pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why does no other person have the same fingerprints as you? (1 mark)
   A. Fingerprints change every day
   B. Fingerprints are drawn at birth
   C. Only twins have fingerprints
   D. Every person is unique

2. What should you do first when you must make a difficult choice? (1 mark)
   A. Ask nobody
   B. Stop and think
   C. Do what your friends do
   D. Choose quickly without thinking

3. Which of these is part of the extended family? (1 mark)
   A. An uncle
   B. A bus driver
   C. A shopkeeper
   D. A classmate

4. Why is it important to know your family members? (1 mark)
   A. It helps you to greet them and understand how you are related
   B. So you can forget them
   C. So you can boast
   D. So you can avoid them

5. What does it mean to honour your parents? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore them
   B. To respect them, obey them and thank them
   C. To argue with them
   D. To hide from them

6. What is a good rule when you are alone with people? (1 mark)
   A. Share private pictures
   B. Accept lifts from strangers
   C. Go to hidden places
   D. Be careful and stay in open places

7. If the first adult you tell does not help you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Tell nobody
   B. Give up
   C. Tell another trusted adult
   D. Forget it

8. If a child is hurt by someone, whose fault is it? (1 mark)
   A. The person who did wrong
   B. The parents
   C. The school
   D. The child

9. What is an attribute of God? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of building
   B. A holiday
   C. A song
   D. A quality that describes what God is like

10. Which of these is an attribute of God taught in this topic? (1 mark)
   A. Sole Creator
   B. Unknown
   C. Weak
   D. Forgetful

11. Which group of books in the Old Testament is known as the Law? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis to Deuteronomy
   B. Job to Song of Songs
   C. Isaiah to Malachi
   D. Joshua to Esther

12. What did Jesus say to Zacchaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Go away
   B. Come down, I must stay at your house today
   C. Sell your house
   D. Follow me to Jerusalem

13. What does it mean to acknowledge God's power? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore God
   B. To admit that our strength comes from Him and thank Him
   C. To hide our talents
   D. To boast about ourselves

14. Who was John the Baptist's mother? (1 mark)
   A. Mary
   B. Anna
   C. Sarah
   D. Elizabeth

15. Where was Zechariah when the angel appeared to him? (1 mark)
   A. By the river
   B. In the temple
   C. On a mountain
   D. At home

16. Where did John preach? (1 mark)
   A. Near the River Jordan
   B. In Antioch
   C. In Rome
   D. In Egypt

17. How did the crowd react? (1 mark)
   A. They laughed
   B. They left in anger
   C. They were filled with awe and praised God
   D. They argued

18. Which verse says, "I am the resurrection and the life"? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 7:14
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. John 11:25

19. What does it mean to forgive? (1 mark)
   A. To stop being angry and not pay the person back
   B. To forget your name
   C. To hide
   D. To hit back

20. Which of these is a physical need? (1 mark)
   A. A toy
   B. A loud radio
   C. A game
   D. Food

21. Who is a needy person? (1 mark)
   A. Only foreigners
   B. Someone who lacks important things like food or clothing
   C. Someone who is wealthy
   D. Only adults

22. What did the woman do when she lost one coin? (1 mark)
   A. Bought another
   B. Lit a lamp, swept the house and searched
   C. Waited
   D. Gave up

23. What does the kingdom of God mean? (1 mark)
   A. A country in Europe
   B. A school
   C. God's rule in the hearts of people who obey Him
   D. A big farm

24. What did Nicodemus say to defend Jesus in John 7:50-51? (1 mark)
   A. Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him?
   B. He is a king
   C. He is a liar
   D. Let us punish Him

25. What did Jesus say a person must be to see the kingdom of God? (1 mark)
   A. Born again
   B. Rich
   C. Old
   D. A priest

26. Who is a stranger? (1 mark)
   A. Your teacher
   B. Someone you do not know
   C. Your cousin
   D. Your grandmother

27. What did Joseph do when he was tempted? (1 mark)
   A. Told everyone
   B. Refused and ran away
   C. Agreed
   D. Stayed to argue

28. Which of these helps us to overcome lying? (1 mark)
   A. Blaming others
   B. Exaggerating
   C. Admitting mistakes quickly
   D. Hiding things

29. Why does a truthful person feel peaceful? (1 mark)
   A. They have nothing to hide
   B. They are old
   C. They are popular
   D. They are rich

30. Which is a result of disobedience? (1 mark)
   A. Praise
   B. Trust
   C. Punishment or harm
   D. Reward

31. Who did the disciples rebuke? (1 mark)
   A. The soldiers
   B. The Pharisees
   C. The people bringing children
   D. The children

32. What did Jesus do to the children? (1 mark)
   A. Ignored them
   B. Gave them money
   C. Placed His hands on them and blessed them
   D. Sent them home

33. Which of these is a result of sin? (1 mark)
   A. It separates us from God
   B. It brings peace
   C. It brings praise
   D. It brings health

34. Why should a child tell a trusted adult if someone touches them wrongly? (1 mark)
   A. To get someone in trouble
   B. For no reason
   C. It is not their fault and the adult can protect them
   D. To boast

35. Which of these shows respect for others' bodies? (1 mark)
   A. Hitting
   B. Bullying
   C. Not hitting or bullying
   D. Touching without permission

36. Which two disciples were brothers, sons of Zebedee? (1 mark)
   A. Thomas and Philip
   B. Matthew and Thaddaeus
   C. James and John
   D. Peter and Andrew

37. Who was stoned for standing firm in his faith? (1 mark)
   A. Andrew
   B. Stephen
   C. Peter
   D. Paul

38. What did Stephen pray for those stoning him? (1 mark)
   A. Send fire
   B. Take me away
   C. Punish them
   D. Lord, do not hold this sin against them

39. Why does the Bible say "fruit" and not "fruits"? (1 mark)
   A. It is a mistake
   B. There is only one
   C. The qualities belong together
   D. It refers to mangoes

40. Which of these can harm the body? (1 mark)
   A. Fruit
   B. Clean water
   C. Rest
   D. Drugs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Describe four steps of how to pray. (4 marks)

42. Explain what Jesus taught in Matthew 5:38-39 and what this teaching does not mean. (5 marks)

43. Describe three steps in planting and caring for a seed. (3 marks)

44. Explain why trusting God is important and how a child shows that they trust Him. (5 marks)

45. Give four ways in which we can care for our eyes and health. (4 marks)

46. State two lessons from Joseph's response to temptation. (2 marks)

47. Describe how the woman searched for the coin and what she did when she found it. (4 marks)

48. Explain what Psalm 119:105 teaches about how the Bible helps us to make right choices. (4 marks)

49. State three reasons why we should care for school property. (3 marks)

50. Who were the parents of John the Baptist? (2 marks)

51. Why is being joyful important for a Christian? Give three reasons. (3 marks)

52. Explain how the story of Samson and the lion shows God's power. (3 marks)

53. State three ways in which the first Christians lived together. (3 marks)

54. Name two things that Samson did in Judges 14:5-9. (2 marks)

55. Give four things that help our faith to grow. (4 marks)

56. State two ways of glorifying God with our bodies. (2 marks)

57. State two ways of coping with anger. (2 marks)

58. Describe how Daniel made a right choice in Babylon and give two lessons a child can learn from him. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Every person is unique
   Fingerprints show that each person is one of a kind.

2. B — Stop and think
   Thinking first helps us to choose well.

3. A — An uncle
   Uncles are relatives outside the nuclear family.

4. A — It helps you to greet them and understand how you are related
   Knowing family helps in respect and relationships.

5. B — To respect them, obey them and thank them
   Honouring includes respect, obedience and thankfulness.

6. D — Be careful and stay in open places
   Safe places and caution protect you.

7. C — Tell another trusted adult
   Keep telling until someone helps.

8. A — The person who did wrong
   It is never the child's fault.

9. D — A quality that describes what God is like
   An attribute is a quality that describes someone.

10. A — Sole Creator
   God is the sole Creator, loving Father and holy.

11. A — Genesis to Deuteronomy
   The first five books are called the Law.

12. B — Come down, I must stay at your house today
   Luke 19:5 records Jesus asking to stay at his house.

13. B — To admit that our strength comes from Him and thank Him
   Acknowledging means to accept and thank.

14. D — Elizabeth
   Elizabeth was Zechariah's wife.

15. B — In the temple
   He was burning incense in the temple.

16. A — Near the River Jordan
   John preached in the wilderness by the Jordan.

17. C — They were filled with awe and praised God
   They said, "A great prophet has appeared."

18. D — John 11:25
   John 11:25 records Jesus' words.

19. A — To stop being angry and not pay the person back
   Forgiving lets go of revenge.

20. D — Food
   Food, water, clothing and shelter are physical needs.

21. B — Someone who lacks important things like food or clothing
   Needy people lack basic things.

22. B — Lit a lamp, swept the house and searched
   Luke 15:8 says she searched carefully.

23. C — God's rule in the hearts of people who obey Him
   God's kingdom is His rule.

24. A — Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him?
   Nicodemus asked for a fair hearing.

25. A — Born again
   John 3:3 records this.

26. B — Someone you do not know
   A stranger is someone you do not know.

27. B — Refused and ran away
   He left his cloak and ran out of the house.

28. C — Admitting mistakes quickly
   Admitting mistakes builds truthfulness.

29. A — They have nothing to hide
   Truth brings a clear conscience.

30. C — Punishment or harm
   Disobedience brings trouble.

31. C — The people bringing children
   They told off those who brought the children.

32. C — Placed His hands on them and blessed them
   Matthew 19:15 says He blessed them.

33. A — It separates us from God
   Sin harms us and others.

34. C — It is not their fault and the adult can protect them
   Telling keeps children safe.

35. C — Not hitting or bullying
   We respect others as God's creation.

36. C — James and John
   James and John were sons of Zebedee.

37. B — Stephen
   Acts 7:54-60.

38. D — Lord, do not hold this sin against them
   Acts 7:60.

39. C — The qualities belong together
   The nine qualities are one fruit.

40. D — Drugs
   Drugs harm the body and mind.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Find a quiet moment, speak with respect, thank Him, say sorry, ask for help, say Amen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step up to 4.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jesus taught that we should not repay evil with evil but respond with peace. It does not mean we must stay in danger or let people harm us. If someone keeps hurting us, we should tell a trusted adult who will protect us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not repaying evil with evil, 1 for peace, 1 for not staying in danger, 1 for telling a trusted adult, 1 for a clear explanation.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dig a hole, plant the seed and cover it, water it regularly, protect it, watch it grow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: God made us, loves us and is faithful. He hears prayers and has helped people in the Bible. A child shows trust by praying every day, reading the Bible, obeying His teaching, and thanking Him for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's love, 1 for faithfulness, 1 for prayer, 1 for Bible or obedience, 1 for thanks.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep hands clean; do not read in dim light; go to the clinic when eyes hurt; eat vegetables and fruit; rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, run away, remember that sin is against God, stay faithful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: She lit a lamp, swept the house, searched carefully until she found it, then called her friends and neighbours to rejoice with her.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: A lamp lights the path so that we can see where to step. The Bible shows us what is right and wrong so that we can choose safely. It guides us in the dark, that is, when we are confused.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the lamp picture, 1 for guidance to right and wrong, 1 for use when confused, 1 for a clear link to choices.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: It belongs to everyone; repair costs money; a clean school helps learning; others will use it later.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: Zechariah and Elizabeth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: It keeps us healthy in mind; it cheers others; it helps us face problems; it shows trust in God. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Samson had no weapon, but the Spirit of the Lord gave him strength to tear a lion apart. This shows God's power is greater than any danger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for no weapon, 1 for the Spirit giving strength, 1 for God's power.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: They learned the teaching, prayed, ate together, shared with the needy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: He killed a lion with his bare hands; he ate honey from the lion's body and shared it with his parents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid action.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: Prayer, Bible reading, worship with others, obedience, good friends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid thing up to 4.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep clean and healthy, speak kindly, avoid harmful things, use hands to help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Breathe deeply, count to ten, walk away, talk to a trusted adult, pray. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

58. (5 marks)
   Answer: Daniel decided not to defile himself with the king's food and politely asked for permission to eat differently. Lessons: it is good to stay faithful to God even when far from home or when no one is watching; we can stand for what is right politely and respectfully; God blesses those who stay faithful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for describing the decision, 1 for politeness or asking permission, 2 for two lessons, 1 for clear expression.
